title: Refine the launch dashboard
description:
## Goal

Turn the launch dashboard into a focused view of revenue momentum and readiness.

## Next steps

- Validate the headline metrics.
- Review the mockup with the launch team.
- Capture the remaining usability questions.

title: Prepare the customer handoff
description:
## Goal

Prepare the support and success teams for the launch.

## Scope

Document the rollout sequence, ownership, and customer communication checkpoints.

title: Keep the current launch date
description:
## Context

Revenue is close to target and the remaining work is understood.

## Decision

Keep the current launch date and focus the next review on churn and onboarding readiness.

title: Use monthly revenue as the primary metric
description:
## Context

The dashboard needs one headline measure that is easy to trace to source data.

## Decision

Lead with monthly revenue and keep customer growth as supporting context.

title: Review launch readiness every Friday
description:
## Question

Should launch readiness be reviewed weekly or only at milestone boundaries?

## Current direction

Use a short Friday review until the launch is complete.

title: Export remains disabled after changing the date range
description:
## What happened

The dashboard recognizes the new range and redraws the chart, but the export control remains disabled until the file is reopened.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the dashboard.
2. Change the reporting period from the default six months to a custom range.
3. Wait for the chart to refresh.
4. Check the export control.

## Expected

The export control becomes available as soon as the refreshed data is ready.

## Actual

The chart updates, but the export control remains disabled.

## Acceptance check

Change the date range and verify the export control becomes available without reopening the file.

title: Target gap rounds inconsistently in the summary
description:
## What happened

The target-gap card rounds to one decimal place while the supporting note uses a whole-dollar value.

## Expected

Both surfaces use the same rounding rule.

title: Launch checklist hides an unassigned owner
description:
## What happened

A checklist row without an owner looks complete at a glance.

## Expected

Unassigned ownership is visible before the launch review.

title: Validate the June revenue total
description: Compare the June total in the spreadsheet with the dashboard headline metric.

title: Review the product brief with stakeholders
description: Confirm that the brief explains the audience, launch goal, and source artifacts clearly.

title: Capture feedback from the dashboard review
description: Record the design questions and turn the agreed changes into follow-up work.
